claims.call: The Panthers’ power play creates at least their usual 8.4 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Canucks’ penalty kill is the league’s worst, and the Panthers’ power play is near the top. Discipline matters more than usual for the Canucks tonight. The Panthers draw a lot of penalties, so their power play should get its chances.

FLA.head: A big edge for the Panthers
FLA.body: Florida has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. It’s on the Canucks to make it a game, and they can if they keep dangerous shots away.

VAN.head: The Canucks are up against it
VAN.body: Florida has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. To pull this off, the Canucks can start with keeping dangerous shots away, plus a goalie who steals the show.
